transcriptions.A:
[page: 1]
Sauerbraten

Ingredients
1/2 l vinegar
1/2 l water
4 sliced onions
pepper
cloves
salt
bay leaves
beef roast

Method
Boil 1/2 l vinegar, 1/2 l water and 4 sliced onions with pepper, cloves,
salt and bay leaves.
Pour the marinade over the beef roast for a shorter rest.
For a longer rest, cool the marinade before adding the beef roast.

[page: 2]
bacon
butter
some apples (optional)
carrots (optional)
juniper berries (optional)
beef drippings
flour
red wine
soaked currants
raisins
sugar to taste

Method
Render the bacon, add butter, then brown the dried beef roast on all sides.
When the roast is browned, pour in a little of the marinade.
Add apples, carrots and juniper berries to the pot if desired.
Cover the pot and braise the beef roast gently until tender.
Stir flour into the beef drippings and loosen the mixture with marinade and red wine.
Add soaked currants, raisins and sugar to taste, balancing sweetness and acidity.
Let the beef roast rest in the sauce before slicing and serving.

changes.reason: Seitan provides a plant-based roast that can be marinated, browned, and braised.
Vegan bacon replaces bacon as the savory fat-rendering component.
Vegan butter supplies the fat for browning and the sauce.
Vegan butter supplies plant-based fat for the flour-based sauce.
A vegan-labelled wine avoids animal-derived clarification agents while providing acidity and depth.
Vegan sugar avoids sugar that may be processed with animal-derived bone char.

changes.after: Stir flour into the vegan butter and loosen the mixture with marinade and vegan-labelled red wine.
changes.reason: Vegan butter supplies the roux fat, and vegan-labelled wine preserves the sauce's acidity and depth.
